A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, for sparse matrix-vector operations, the CM-200 performs best when the matrix is stored in the compressed row format.
the best performance is achieved when the sparse matrix is stored in a compressed row format and the matrix-vector operation is performed by a direct method.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance of sparse computations on the CM machines is highly dependent on the sparsity of the input matrix and the number of processors used for the computation.
the CM-200 can outperform the CM-5 by a factor of 10 for the sparse matrix-vector multiplication.
the data parallel mode is a very efficient environment for sparse computations, but that there are many ways of implementing sparse operations that have widely different performance characteristics.
